D. 490. --वृद्धिः f. accumulation of wealth. --व्ययः expenditure; ˚ज्ञ a. conversant with money-matters. --शास्त्रं {1} the science of wealth (political economy). {2} science of polity, political science, politics; Dk. 120; इह खलु अर्थशास्त्रकारास्त्रिविधां सिद्धिमुपवर्णयंति Mu. 3; ˚व्यवहारिन् one dealing with politics, a politician; Mu. 5. {3} science giving precepts on general conduct, the science of practical life; Pt. 1. --शौचं purity or honesty in money-matters; सर्वेषां चैव शौचानामर्थशौचं परं स्मृतं Ms. 5. 106. --संस्थानं {1} accumulation of wealth. {2} treasury. --संग्रहः, --संचयः accumulation or acquisition of wealth, wealth, treasure, property. --समाजः aggregate of causes. --समाहारः {1} treasure. {2} acquisition of wealth. --संपद् f. accomplishment of a desired object; Ki. 1. 15. --संबंधः connection of the sense with he word or sentence. --साधक a. {1} accomplishing any object. {2} bringing any matter to a conclusion. --सारः considerable wealth; Pt. 2. 42. --सिद्ध a. understood from the very context (though not expressed in words), inferable from the connection of words. --सिद्धिः f. fulfilment of a desired object, success. --हर a. inheriting wealth. --हीन a. {1} deprived of wealth, poor. {2} unmeaning, nonsensical. {3} failing.
